title: Mollifications of a distributionally harmonic L^1(B) function are smooth and harmonic on B_{1-eps}
statement: Let n >= 1, B the open unit ball of R^n, and w : R^n -> R integrable on B with int_B w Laplacian(zeta) = 0 for every zeta in C^infinity(R^n) with compact support and tsupport zeta in B. Let kappa : R^n -> R be C^infinity and eps a real number with kappa(z) = 0 whenever |z| >= eps. Then v(x) := int_B kappa(x - y) w(y) dy is C^infinity on R^n and Laplacian(v)(x) = 0 for every x with |x| < 1 - eps.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ w : Rn n → ℝ, IntegrableOn w (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball 0 1 → ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, w x * Laplacian.laplacian ζ x = 0) → ∀ (κ : Rn n → ℝ) (ε : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ → (∀ z : Rn n, ε ≤ ‖z‖ → κ z = 0) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => ∫ y in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, κ (x - y) * w y) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 - ε), Laplacian.laplacian (fun x => ∫ y in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, κ (x - y) * w y) x = 0
